verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for an AI app-building platform, but the evidence pack documents no Lovable command-line tool. The access surfaces it does show are a web editor, a desktop app, mobile apps, an MCP server, Slack and Telegram bots, and Build-with-URL links, none of which is a CLI. Git sync lets users work locally with their own tools, but that is a user-side workaround, not an official Lovable CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
